description: Requêtes SQL des versions publiées du cockpit (app/server hors tests), relevées le 2026-09-15 en lecture seule sur les tags v1.0.2, v1.0.3 et v1.0.4 : les trois ensembles sont identiques. Rejouées dans l'ordre par migration5.test.ts sur une base en version 5 (compatibilité descendante I5), sans git en CI. Une requête à fragments est recopiée pour chacune de ses formes (filtres des Archives, coût moyen par demande, compteurs du diagnostic, résumé mensuel). Valeurs d'exemple sans secret ; marqueurs d'extrait de recherche remplacés par [ et ].

nonRejouees.raison: boucle de migration des versions 1.0.x (3 entrées) : ni cette requête ni leurs migrations ne s'exécutent sur une base de version 3 ou plus

requetes.sql: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON; PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000; PRAGMA secure_delete = ON;
PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL; PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL;
PRAGMA user_version
BEGIN IMMEDIATE
COMMIT
BEGIN IMMEDIATE
ROLLBACK

INSERT INTO sessions (id, parent_id, root_id, directory, project_id, title, purpose, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :parent_id, :root_id, :directory, :project_id, :title, :purpose, :created_at, :updated_at) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET parent_id = excluded.parent_id, root_id = excluded.root_id, directory = excluded.directory, project_id = excluded.project_id, title = excluded.title, purpose = CASE WHEN sessions.purpose = 'classifier' THEN 'classifier' ELSE excluded.purpose END, updated_at = MAX(sessions.updated_at, excluded.updated_at)

INSERT INTO usage (message_id, session_id, root_id, directory, provider_id, model_id, agent, purpose, parent_message_id, created_at, completed_at, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, cost_reported, cost_estimated, cost, cost_source, error) VALUES (:message_id, :session_id, :root_id, :directory, :provider_id, :model_id, :agent, :purpose, :parent_message_id, :created_at, :completed_at, :tokens_input, :tokens_output, :tokens_reasoning, :tokens_cache_read, :tokens_cache_write, :cost_reported, :cost_estimated, :cost, :cost_source, :error) ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET root_id = excluded.root_id, completed_at = excluded.completed_at, agent = excluded.agent, purpose = excluded.purpose, tokens_input = excluded.tokens_input, tokens_output = excluded.tokens_output, tokens_reasoning = excluded.tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read = excluded.tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write = excluded.tokens_cache_write, cost_reported = excluded.cost_reported, cost_estimated = excluded.cost_estimated, cost = excluded.cost, cost_source = excluded.cost_source, error = excluded.error

INSERT INTO usage (message_id, session_id, root_id, directory, provider_id, model_id, agent, purpose, parent_message_id, created_at, completed_at, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, cost_reported, cost_estimated, cost, cost_source, error) VALUES (:message_id, :session_id, :root_id, :directory, :provider_id, :model_id, :agent, :purpose, :parent_message_id, :created_at, :completed_at, :tokens_input, :tokens_output, :tokens_reasoning, :tokens_cache_read, :tokens_cache_write, :cost_reported, :cost_estimated, :cost, :cost_source, :error) ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET root_id = excluded.root_id, completed_at = excluded.completed_at, agent = excluded.agent, purpose = excluded.purpose, tokens_input = excluded.tokens_input, tokens_output = excluded.tokens_output, tokens_reasoning = excluded.tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read = excluded.tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write = excluded.tokens_cache_write, cost_reported = excluded.cost_reported, cost_estimated = excluded.cost_estimated, cost = excluded.cost, cost_source = excluded.cost_source, error = excluded.error

INSERT INTO prompts (message_id, session_id, root_id, directory, provider_id, model_id, agent, created_at) VALUES (:message_id, :session_id, :root_id, :directory, :provider_id, :model_id, :agent, :created_at) ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET root_id = excluded.root_id

INSERT INTO prompts (message_id, session_id, root_id, directory, provider_id, model_id, agent, created_at) VALUES (:message_id, :session_id, :root_id, :directory, :provider_id, :model_id, :agent, :created_at) ON CONFLICT(message_id) DO UPDATE SET root_id = excluded.root_id
UPDATE sessions SET root_id = ? WHERE root_id = ?
UPDATE usage SET root_id = ? WHERE root_id = ?
UPDATE prompts SET root_id = ? WHERE root_id = ?
SELECT root_id FROM sessions WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, parent_id FROM sessions WHERE root_id = ? AND parent_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT ?
SELECT DISTINCT directory FROM sessions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND directory != '' AND updated_at >= ? LIMIT 100
SELECT message_id, provider_id, model_id, cost_reported, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write FROM usage WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?
UPDATE usage SET cost = ?, cost_estimated = ?, cost_source = ? WHERE message_id = ?
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total FROM usage WHERE created_at >= ? AND created_at < ?
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO budget_alerts (month, threshold, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.message_id) AS prompts, COALESCE(SUM(u.cost), 0) AS cost FROM prompts p JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id AND s.purpose = 'chat' AND s.parent_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.root_id = p.root_id AND u.created_at >= p.created_at AND u.created_at < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(p2.created_at) FROM prompts p2 WHERE p2.root_id = p.root_id AND p2.created_at > p.created_at), 9e15) WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.provider_id = ? AND p.model_id = ?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.message_id) AS prompts, COALESCE(SUM(u.cost), 0) AS cost FROM prompts p JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id AND s.purpose = 'chat' AND s.parent_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.root_id = p.root_id AND u.created_at >= p.created_at AND u.created_at < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(p2.created_at) FROM prompts p2 WHERE p2.root_id = p.root_id AND p2.created_at > p.created_at), 9e15) WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.agent = ? AND p.provider_id = ? AND p.model_id = ?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.message_id) AS prompts, COALESCE(SUM(u.cost), 0) AS cost FROM prompts p JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id AND s.purpose = 'chat' AND s.parent_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN usage u ON u.root_id = p.root_id AND u.created_at >= p.created_at AND u.created_at < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(p2.created_at) FROM prompts p2 WHERE p2.root_id = p.root_id AND p2.created_at > p.created_at), 9e15) WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.agent = ?
INSERT INTO chat_turns (session_id, created_at, kind, agent, command, tier, model, variant, runs) VALUES (:session_id, :created_at, :kind, :agent, :command, :tier, :model, :variant, :runs)
SELECT agent, tier, model, variant, created_at FROM chat_turns WHERE session_id = ? AND kind = 'message' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost),0) cost, COUNT(*) calls, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_input),0) ti, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_output),0) tout, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_reasoning),0) tr, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_cache_read),0) tcr, COALESCE(SUM(tokens_cache_write),0) tcw FROM usage WHERE root_id = ?
SELECT provider_id AS providerID, model_id AS modelID, SUM(cost) AS cost, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM usage WHERE root_id = ? GROUP BY provider_id, model_id ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS m FROM usage ORDER BY m DESC
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE session_id = ?

INSERT INTO conversations (session_id, directory, title, category, tags, summary, classified_by, confidence, classified_at, prompts_at_classification, created_at, updated_at, prompt_count, message_count, cost, models, tools, files, additions, deletions) VALUES (:session_id, :directory, :title, :category, :tags, :summary, 'heuristic', :confidence, :classified_at, :prompt_count, :created_at, :updated_at, :prompt_count, :message_count, :cost, :models, :tools, :files, :additions, :deletions)

UPDATE conversations SET directory = :directory, title = CASE WHEN title_manual = 1 THEN title ELSE :title END, updated_at = :updated_at, prompt_count = :prompt_count, message_count = :message_count, cost = :cost, models = :models, tools = :tools, files = :files, additions = :additions, deletions = :deletions, deleted_in_opencode = 0 WHERE session_id = :session_id
DELETE FROM conversations_fts WHERE session_id = ?
INSERT INTO conversations_fts (session_id, title, summary, tags, transcript) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
SELECT transcript FROM conversations_fts WHERE session_id = ?
UPDATE conversations SET category = ?, tags = ?, summary = ?, classified_by = ?, confidence = ?, classified_at = ?, prompts_at_classification = prompt_count WHERE session_id = ?
UPDATE conversations SET title = ? WHERE session_id = ?

UPDATE conversations SET category = :category, tags = :tags, title = :title, title_manual = :title_manual, summary = :summary, pinned = :pinned, classified_by = :classified_by WHERE session_id = :session_id
UPDATE conversations SET deleted_in_opencode = 1 WHERE session_id = ?

SELECT c.*, snippet(conversations_fts, 4, :snip_open, :snip_close, '…', 16) AS snippet FROM conversations_fts JOIN conversations c ON c.session_id = conversations_fts.session_id WHERE conversations_fts MATCH :q ORDER BY c.pinned DESC, bm25(conversations_fts, 0, 8, 4, 4, 1) LIMIT 500

SELECT c.*, snippet(conversations_fts, 4, :snip_open, :snip_close, '…', 16) AS snippet FROM conversations_fts JOIN conversations c ON c.session_id = conversations_fts.session_id WHERE conversations_fts MATCH :q AND c.category = :category AND c.updated_at >= :from AND c.updated_at < :to AND c.pinned = 1 ORDER BY c.pinned DESC, bm25(conversations_fts, 0, 8, 4, 4, 1) LIMIT 500
SELECT c.* FROM conversations c ORDER BY c.pinned DESC, c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 2000
SELECT c.* FROM conversations c WHERE c.category = :category AND c.updated_at >= :from AND c.updated_at < :to AND c.pinned = 1 ORDER BY c.pinned DESC, c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 2000
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS conversations, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS cost, MAX(updated_at) AS lastAt FROM conversations GROUP BY category
SELECT DISTINCT directory FROM conversations
UPDATE conversations SET archive_path = ? WHERE session_id = ?

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost),0) cost, COUNT(*) calls, SUM(tokens_input) ti, SUM(tokens_output) tout, SUM(tokens_reasoning) tr, SUM(tokens_cache_read) tcr, SUM(tokens_cache_write) tcw FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM prompts p JOIN sessions s ON s.id = p.session_id WHERE s.purpose = 'chat' AND s.parent_id IS NULL AND p.created_at >= :start AND p.created_at < :end
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', u.created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') day, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT provider_id providerID, model_id modelID, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls, SUM(tokens_input + tokens_cache_read + tokens_cache_write) tokensIn, SUM(tokens_output + tokens_reasoning) tokensOut FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY provider_id, model_id ORDER BY cost DESC, calls DESC
SELECT agent, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY agent ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT purpose, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT directory, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY directory ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(c.category, 'unclassified') category, SUM(u.cost) cost, COUNT(DISTINCT u.root_id) conversations FROM usage u LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.session_id = u.root_id WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end AND u.purpose != 'classifier' GROUP BY category ORDER BY cost DESC
SELECT cost_source source, SUM(cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls FROM usage u WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end GROUP BY cost_source

SELECT u.root_id rootId, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.title, ''), s.title, '') title, COALESCE(s.directory, u.directory) directory, c.category category, SUM(u.cost) cost, COUNT(*) calls, MAX(u.created_at) lastAt FROM usage u LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = u.root_id LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.session_id = u.root_id WHERE u.created_at >= :start AND u.created_at < :end AND u.purpose != 'classifier' GROUP BY u.root_id ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.created_at, u.root_id, u.session_id, u.directory, u.agent, u.purpose, u.provider_id, u.model_id, u.tokens_input, u.tokens_output, u.tokens_reasoning, u.tokens_cache_read, u.tokens_cache_write, u.cost, u.cost_source, COALESCE(c.category, '') category, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.title,''), s.title, '') title FROM usage u LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.id = u.root_id LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.session_id = u.root_id WHERE u.created_at >= ? AND u.created_at < ? ORDER BY u.created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sessions
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM usage
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM prompts
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM conversations
